fund.name: T-Strive Digital Credit Preferred Income ETF
fund.investment_objective: The T-Strive Digital Credit Preferred Income ETF (the "Fund") is an actively managed ETF seeking current income. Under normal market conditions, the Fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in preferred securities issued by Bitcoin treasury companies and derivatives transactions that provide exposure to those securities.
fund.strategy_blurb: The Fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks current income. Under normal market conditions, the Fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in preferred securities issued by Bitcoin treasury companies ("Digital Credit Preferred Securities") and derivatives transactions that provide exposure to Digital Credit Preferred Securities. At inception, the Fund expects to focus its investments principally on Strategy Inc. Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock ("STRC") and Strive, Inc. Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock ("SATA"), and may obtain exposure through direct investments and through total return swaps and other derivative instruments. The Fund may use leverage tactically and intends to write put options on Digital Credit Preferred Securities. The Fund will not invest directly in Bitcoin.
fund.fee_footnote: The Adviser has contractually agreed to waive its management fee to an annual rate of 0.65% of the average daily net assets of the Fund until September 30, 2027 and the Adviser may not terminate this arrangement prior to that date.
